summary: Iteration 11 backend-only testing of the pump.fun new-listing detector. Created /app/backend/tests/test_pumpfun_sniper.py (30 tests) covering: PUMPFUN_PROGRAM == '6EF8rrecthR5Dkzon8Nwu78hRvfCKubJ14M5uBEwF6P'; get_pumpfun_sniper(db) singleton returns identical instance on subsequent no-arg calls and raises RuntimeError if first call omits db; source scan confirms NO buy/swap/jupiter/send_transaction/keypair/private-key code path exists (detection-only verified); subscribe payload literal matches Solana logsSubscribe spec (params[0]={'mentions':[PUMPFUN_PROGRAM]}, params[1]={'commitment':'processed'}) and was additionally asserted at runtime through a fully mocked aiohttp ClientSession/WebSocket that also proves non-JSON frames and non-logsNotification frames are ignored while a Create notification is dispatched. start() safety: no-op (no task, running False, no exception even outside an event loop) when PUMPFUN_SNIPER_ENABLED is unset, when QUICKNODE_WSS_URL is http:// (non-wss), and when both QUICKNODE_WSS_URL and SOLANA_RPC_URL are empty; stop() is safe with no task. _handle_log_notification with a mocked DB: Create log increments total_events + detections, sets last_detection_at, and inserts one doc with candidate_mint='SomePumpMintAddress1234567890abcdefghijk', signature, slot=42, solscan_url, pumpfun_url and raw_log_count=3; a Buy/swap log increments total_events only (detections stays 0, no insert); malformed payload does not raise; 3 Create + 1 Buy -> total_events=4, detections=3, 3 inserts. Cap logic with count_documents=1005 issues exactly one delete_many({'_id': {'$in': [...5 oldest ids]}}) and never delete_one; no delete when count=10. API via public URL: GET /api/live/pumpfun/status 200 with all 9 required keys, enabled=false, running=false, last_detection_at=null, last_error=null, int counters, note contains 'DETECTION-ONLY' and 'does NOT auto-buy'; GET /api/live/pumpfun/detections?limit=50 200 -> {count:0, detections:[]}, no _id leakage, limit=1 honoured. Full regression: 277/277 pytest PASS (247 baseline from iteration 10 + 30 new), zero regressions across /api/health, /api/live/status, /api/live/auto_arb/status, /api/live/auto_arb/decisions, /api/live/trades, /api/live/summary, /api/live/rpc_ping, /api/live/balance, /api/live/test_swap (POST, refuses in default env), /api/bot_diagnostic, /api/stats. Frontend testing skipped as requested.

minor.issue: If _connect_and_listen() returns normally (server closes the WS cleanly / subscription rejected without raising), the while-loop immediately reconnects with NO sleep. Against a flaky or auth-rejecting QuickNode endpoint this becomes a tight reconnect loop that will hammer the RPC and burn credits. The 10s backoff only applies on exception. Add an unconditional sleep (or backoff) after each _connect_and_listen return.

candidate_mint is extracted only from log lines containing 'mint:' with a >=40-char tail. Real pump.fun create transactions emit the mint inside a base64 'Program data:' anchor event, not a human-readable 'Program log: mint: <addr>' line, so in production candidate_mint will very often be None and pumpfun_url will be null — the detection row then has no actionable token. Consider decoding the anchor CPI event data or fetching the tx's postTokenBalances to resolve the mint.

count_documents({}) runs on EVERY detection. During a pump.fun burst (dozens of new mints per minute) that is an extra full-collection count per event. Throttle it (e.g. only every Nth detection) or use a capped collection / TTL index instead.
No unique index on `signature` and no dedupe, so a re-delivered logsNotification (which Solana WS can do across reconnects) will insert duplicate detection rows and double-count self.detections.
`limit` is unbounded and unvalidated: limit=-1 / limit=0 / limit=1000000 are passed straight to Mongo. Add Query(50, ge=1, le=500).

Both swallow exceptions and return HTTP 200 with an {'error': ...} body instead of a 5xx. Monitoring cannot distinguish healthy from broken. (Consistent with the rest of this codebase, so low priority.)

action_items: Add an unconditional backoff sleep in PumpFunSniper._loop so a clean WS close cannot cause a tight reconnect loop.
Improve mint extraction: current 'mint:' heuristic will yield candidate_mint=None for most real pump.fun create txs.
Throttle count_documents in the 1000-row cap path (or switch to TTL/capped collection).
Bound the `limit` query param on /api/live/pumpfun/detections with Query(50, ge=1, le=500) and add a unique index / dedupe on signature.
critical_code_review_comments: pumpfun_sniper._loop: only the exception branch backs off 10s; a normal return from _connect_and_listen reconnects instantly — unbounded reconnect storm risk against QuickNode.

self.running is set to True in start() and never cleared when _loop exits, so status().running relies solely on task.done(); if the task is cancelled externally the flag stays stale. Reset self.running=False at the end of _loop.
logger.warning(f"[pumpfun] no valid WSS URL — set QUICKNODE_WSS_URL") is an f-string with no placeholders (harmless lint issue).
Detection-only claim verified: no swap/jupiter/keypair/private_key/send_transaction symbols exist anywhere in pumpfun_sniper.py.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Baseline is now 277 pytest tests, all passing, run with `cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/ -p no:anchorpy -q` (the -p no:anchorpy flag is required). New file this iteration: tests/test_pumpfun_sniper.py. rca_of_the_issue: No functional defects found. The two initial test failures were both test-script issues that I fixed in scope: (1) the 'no BUY code' source scan banned the substring 'sign', which false-matched 'signature' in the detection doc — narrowed to 'sign_transaction'/'private_key'; (2) the /api/live/test_swap regression check POSTed with no body and got 422 — corrected to send the LiveTestSwapRequest payload.
